Commentary.Commentary: Talking about the visitors' batting performance, only Glenn Maxwell, Peter Handscomb and Matthew Wade provided some resistance. The rest couldn't comprehend the bowling of the hosts. But they will have to put that behind them and concentrate on the last six overs on Day 3 first. A wicket or two in this phase will put India under pressure. The hosts, on the other hand, will aim to finish the day unscathered. Can they do so? Let's find out.

This Test keeps showing this format of the game is the best! A collective bowling performance from the Indian bowlers has ensured that the task to regain the Border-Gavaskar Trophy is not too hard for them. Ask them if they would take that total for the chase after their innings and they would have nodded in unison. But they would have to be wary of the deck. It has started playing tricks. The cracks have opened up and the Indian pacers used that to their advantage. The ball also started spinning a lot with uneven bounce. The Indian bowlers bowled well as a unit. Ashwin, Jadeja, Umesh Yadav chipped in with three wickets each. Having said that, the Australians will have to bowl out of their skins to bundle India out below 106.

OUT! All over for Australia! Bowls it around off, Hazlewood comes forward to defend but is hit on his pads. The ball carries to the silly point fielder and he takes it and appeals too. The umpire rules it out. Hazlewood walks down has a chat with Wade and goes for the review. Ball Tracker shows that impact was in line and it was clipping the stumps so Hazlewood has to walk back. The third umpire informs Ian Gould to signal it out yet again as his decision was reviewed. Australia dismissed for 137, India need 106 runs to win the game and the series!
Josh Hazlewood has taken a review. He has been adjudged LBW. Seems more tactical as he doesn't seem too confident.
Lands it outside off, left alone.

NOT OUT! Drama! Ashwin floats it outside off, Hazlewood comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge. Murali Vijay at gully takes the catch and appeals. He just takes off to go into the dressing room knowing that he has to bat soon. Hazlewood is not going anywhere though. The umpires come together and refer it upstairs to check if the catch was clean. Replays show it is close. Vijay had his fingers underneath it but looks like some part of the ball was touching the ground. It is given not out. Half of the Indian side was walking back but now have to get back in their positions. Vijay too makes his way back on the field. He signals to his teammates that he had fingers underneath it. The decision is not going to change though.
Hazlewood is caught in the slips and India are confident. The umpires get together and refer it upstairs. The soft signal is out.
Lands it on middle and off, Josh comes forward and defends it.
Flatter on off, Josh defends it watchfully.

Length ball outside off, Wade gets across and pulls it towards mid on. Rahane fumbles a touch and allows the second run. The throw comes in at the non-striker's end and Umesh accidentally deflects it onto the stumps but no harm done. Wade is not happy as he wanted three to keep strike.
FOUR! Hit away! Shorter outside off, Wade stands tall and cuts it hard through point for a boundary. That was in the air but there was no fielder to bother him.
Length ball outside off, Wade creams his drive but finds extra cover.
Bowls it outside off, driven towards mid off by Wade.
Wade gets across and tucks it towards the on side.

Dropped! Shorter outside off, Wade goes for the cut shot. The ball flies off the edge and carries to Ashwin at first slip who does not pick it at all and drops the catch. Umesh Yadav is not impressed at all. Ravi Shastri on air asks why is Ashwin standing at first slip and why not Ajinkya Rahane, valid question too. Wade will want to make India pay for this mistake.
Fuller outside off, Josh comes forward and defends it.
With just a ball to go, Wade takes the single with a nudge towards mid-wicket.
Wade gets across and sweeps it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
SIX! Loopy outside off, Wade slinks down the wicket and hits it over extra cover for a maximum. Superb shot, that!
Wade comes down the wicket and pushes it towards mid off.
Floats it on the stumps, Wade goes for the slog sweep and gets it towards mid-wicket.
Ravichandran Ashwin returns for a bowl.
Shorter outside off, Hazlewood stays back and punches it through point. Wade is not talking the single though.
Gets behind the line of this one and defends it.
Shorter outside off, Hazlewood looks to guide it but is beaten.
Josh Hazlewood is the last man in.

OUT! Umesh Yadav strikes in time! Bowls it outside off on a length, Lyon pushes at it from his crease. The ball goes off the outside edge and flies to second slip. Vijay takes the catch and that is the third wicket for Umesh Yadav. Australia are falling like nine pins. Wade might reflect on his mistake now, he will surely farm the strike from hereon.

Beaten! Floats it around off, Lyon shapes to drive it but is beaten all ends up. The keeper takes the bails off and appeals but no harm done as Lyon had not left the crease.

Nathan Lyon is the new man in.

It flies quickly to the left of Cheteshwar Pujara who takes it on his second attempt at silly point. That's a superb catch from him and the pair of Pujara and Jadeja continue to hurt Australia in the series. The lead for Australia is still 89 runs!

Replay suggests that Maxwell's foot was well inside the crease. There was a sound too as the ball passed the bat, but it was off the bat hitting the ground.
The third umpire is referred for a stumping appeal against Maxwell.

Tossed up, outside off, Matthew prods forward in defense.

NOT OUT! Wade survives! Lands it on off, Wade is on his back foot as he looks to defend it. He misses and is hit on his front pad. The players go up in an appeal but the umpire stays put. India contemplate about the review and eventually Ashwin convinces Ajinkya Rahane to go for it. Replays confirm there was no bat there. Ball Tracker shows it would have flicked the bails and the umpire's call stays. Wade survives. Close call, that! India lose a review.

R Ashwin to continue from the other end.

Short and turning in, Wade rocks back and defends it to the FSL.
Tossed up around off, Wade defends it off the outer half towards point.
The players are out in the field. Glenn Maxwell is joined by the new man Matthew Wade. Jadeja will end his over.
...DAY 3, SESSION 3...

Australia were 0/3 when they lost Matt Renshaw, but Glenn Maxwell, who has looked extremely fluent so far, and Peter Handscomb weathered the storm and stitched together a 56-run stand. But the partnership ended when Ajinkya Rahane took a blinder at first slip off Ashwin's bowling. The icing on the cake for the home side was the wicket of Shaun Marsh. The visitors are in a precarious position and have five wickets left. How much more can they add? Join us in the third session to find out.

It seemed like that the first hour belonged to India, while second to Australia. But two late wickets at the stroke of Tea has ensured that the hosts take the honours of this session. Sumptuous fast bowling, quick scoring, smart captaincy, we have seen it all in this passage of play. David Warner was dropped early, which made us all think whether it will cost the hosts again. But it didn't! Umesh Yadav and Bhuvneshwar Kumar came together to bowl one of the most threatening spells from a pair of Indian pacers. It seemed like they would strike every ball.

OUT! Marsh is walking and Australia are in deep trouble! Jadeja bowls it outside off, not quite on the driving length. Shaun Marsh lunges forward to defend but is not up to it. The ball goes off the gloves and lobs towards Cheteshwar Pujara at short leg, who takes the catch towards his right. Two vital wickets for India in quick time, Australia are effectively 60/5 here. That will also be Tea, Day 3!
Bowls it outside off, pushed into covers.
Fuller outside off, Marsh comes forward and defends it.
Marsh comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge past short leg for a single.
Floats it outside off, Marsh comes forward and defends it.
Four Byes! Lands it on leg, Marsh fails to clip it through and the ball beats the keeper too. It runs into the fine leg fence. Byes signaled by the umpire.
Shaun Marsh strides out in the middle. He is not completely fit as he is experiencing pain in his back.

OUT! The skippers are having a good game in the slips too. Rahane has taken a stunner again! Ashwin lands it outside off, the ball does not spin and goes straight on. Bounces more on Peter Handscomb who is on his back foot to defend it. The ball takes the outside edge and flies to Ajinkya Rahane at first slip. He reacts really well to it, going towards his right and takes it head high. He sits down there stunned as to how did he manage to take that one. End of a crucial stand for Australia, Handscomb has to walk back.
This one is on the stumps, Maxwell sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Lands it outside off, Maxwell sweeps it hard but finds Pujara at short leg. That hit Pujara on his neck. Maxwell went up to have a word.
In the air... but safe! Flatter outside off, Handscomb looks to drive it in the air but finds the silly point fielder. The ball bounced as it went to the fielder.
Handscomb comes forward and defends it.
Low bounce! Flatter outside off, does not get up at all, Peter looks to defend it off his crease but fails to do so. That was not far from the stumps.
This one is driven through covers for a single.
Maxwell comes forward and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Maxwell drives it through covers. Murali Vijay gets across from sweeper cover, dives and stops the ball from going through. A couple taken.
Change of ends for Ravindra Jadeja.
Lands it outside off, spins in a touch with some extra bounce, Handscomb goes back to work it through square leg but gets hit on his back pad.
Flatter outside off, Handscomb stays back and blocks it.
Floats it outside off, Maxwell clips it towards mid on. The bowler, Ashwin goes to his right, tries to stop it with his right boot but fails to do so. A single results.
Bowls it outside off, pushed towards extra cover. They think of a single but decide against it.

Ravichandran Ashwin brought on for a bowl.

50-run stand up between Maxwell and Handscomb.

Flatter on the stumps, Peter goes back and tucks it towards short leg.
A touch short, Maxwell goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.

Loops it outside off, Maxwell drives it through covers for a single. He has moved onto 31 already, the lead is now 45.

Edged! Maxwell stays back to defend but gets an outside edge towards point for a single.

Is that bowled? No it is not. Floats it outside off, Peter Handscomb looks to defend it coming forward but fails to do so. The ball goes through the gap between the bat and pad. It bounces over the stumps. That was close! India ponder over a review but Saha is unsure so opt against it.

Loops it on off, comes in, Maxwell lunges forward and defends it.

FOUR! He's picking Kuldeep well now! Shorter one around off, Maxwell exposes his stumps and punches it through covers for a boundary.

Handscomb comes forward and pushes it towards covers.

Angles this on a full delivery and on off, well blocked.
On a length and around off, Handscomb defends it with an angled bat towards the leg side.
Peter Handscomb is the new man in. Sanjay Manjrekar on air, informs that Shaun Marsh has a jarred back and hence has not come out to bat at his regular position. He will bat if required.

OUT! India manage to dismiss Steven Smith early and it is a huge, huge wicket. Bhuvneshwar Kumar knows it, the Dharamsala crowd knows it and is buzzing. A fist pump by Bhuvi to release the pressure he was under after being hit for two boundaries. He bowls this marginally short, and keeps it around off, Smith thinks opts for the pull shot but it is not quite there to be pulled. The ball takes the inside edge and the off stump goes for a walk. He gestures to Renshaw that ball swung in. A rare misjudgement from a player who is in immense touch. What a wicket for India, Australia still trail by a run.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Smith. This time Bhuvi bowls it very full and outside off, Smith stays in his crease and creams it through  point for a boundary. Umesh from deep third man ran across to stop it but the ball was too fast for him.

FOUR! Australia are only five runs behind now. Back of a length delivery around leg, Smith swivels a bit and helps it along to the square leg fence for a boundary. Too easy this for the Australian skipper.
Shortish delivery and outside off, Renshaw taps it towards the off side.
R Ashwin is fielding at first slip now, he wasn't in the slip cordon before.
FOUR! Poor delivery which might release some pressure. Back of a length delivery around leg, Renshaw gets across and tucks it very fine for a boundary to the fine leg fence.
Good length delivery, outside off, Renshaw looks to guide it towards third man but the ball takes the outside edge and goes on the bounce to Murali Vijay at second slip.
Short of a length and outside off, Renshaw gets over the ball to defend it.
Fuller again and on the sticks, Renshaw opens the face of the bat and places it towards point.
Very full and on the sticks, Smith flicks it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length and outside off, the southpaw has decided to offer no shot.
Bouncer! Renshaw sways out of its way with a duck.
Fuller delivery and on the sticks, Renshaw blocks.
Length delivery, swinging in, Renshaw carefully defends it.
Bowls this fuller and outside off, Matt leaves it alone. The ball hardly bounced as Saha collected it.
Bhuvi goes around the wicket.
Good length delivery, on the off stump, defended.
Angles in a fuller delivery and around off, Smith blocks it with a straight face of the bat.
Back of a length delivery around off, for a very short moment Smith thinks of pulling it at first but then opts against it and lets it go.
Fullish delivery and outside off, Smith leaves it alone. The ball stays low again.
Marginally ahead of a length and swinging in, Smith nudges it through fine leg for a couple.
Lands this on a full length and in the line of the fifth stump, Steven shoulders his arms.
Angles in a fuller delivery and on the sticks, Smith bunts it towards the mid on fielder.
Fullish delivery and outside off, Renshaw plays inside the line and Saha collects it on the first bounce.
On a length and around leg, Renshaw looks to tuck it away but the cherry swings in and raps him on the thigh pad.
Fuller and around off, Renshaw is rock solid in defense.
Fuller and angling in, Smith flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and outside off, Smith ignores it.
Short of a length delivery, around off, Smith gets on his toes to stonewall it.
Ouch! Umesh hits the deck hard, Renshaw tries to get away from the ball with a half-duck but the cherry stays low and hits him on the right arm. Good period of play for India, this.
On a length and in the line of the fourth stump, Renshaw is rock solid in defense.
Back of a length delivery, around off, Matt pats it towards covers.
Smith flicks this fullish delivery towards square leg for a run.

FOUR! Well, what can one say about Smith's class? Agreed the ball was poor and on the pads, but it still had to be put away and he did that brilliantly. Shuffles a bit and just tucks it through square leg for a boundary. The fine leg fielder hared across to stop it but to no avail.
In walks Steven Smith at Number 3. He has had the wood over India in this series, how will he go today?

OUT! Karun Nair will be the most happy person in Dharamsala right now. This riveting spell of fast bowling gives India a wicket. Umesh bowls this on a length and outside off, Warner tries to push it down the ground but only manages a faint edge which Saha grabs quite easily. Umesh appeals and the umpire gives Warner the marching orders. The dropped catch doesn't cost much like it did in the first innings and the southpaw departs for six. Australia still trail by 22 runs.
Renshaw pats this length delivery towards point.
Bowls this down the leg side, Renshaw tries to flick but it is out of his reach.
On a length and outside off, Renshaw has left it alone.
Bangs this short, Renshaw has nothing to do with it.

DROPPED! Karun Nair puts down David Warner yet again! Good length delivery, around off, David looks to guide it but it takes the outside edge and flies towards Nair at third slip. He dives to his left, gets his hands to it but the ball pops out. Rahane from gully tries to catch it on the rebound but he too only gets hand to it but does not grab onto the chance. They run a single in that time. Skipper Rahane pats Karun on the back to console him. But that should have been taken. He dropped Warner in a similar manner in the first innings, difference was this time he went at it with two hands and not one. How much will the drop cost India?

NASTY! Bhuvneshwar bangs this short, yes you read it right. Warner certainly didn't expect it and got surprised. He looks to defend but then opts out of it. The cherry hits him on the shoulder. That must have hurt him. Both Warner and Renshaw come together to have a look at the crack from where the ball kicked off.
On a length, outside off, Renshaw plays inside the line and gets beaten.

Jaffa! Umesh bowls a bouncer. Renshaw hops and looks to fend it away but the ball whizzes past his gloves and Saha leaps in the air to collect it with one hand. That is a seriously good ball from Umesh, good start for him.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, Matt has allowed Saha to gather it.
Beautiful delivery! Marginally ahead of a length and around off, Renshaw goes back to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, Warner pats it towards covers for a single.

FOUR! Gets off the mark in some style but with too much risk. Umesh bowls a good length delivery and outside off, Warner throws his hands at hit and slashes it hard. The cherry races away towards third man for a boundary.
Umesh Yadav to bowl from the other end. Three slips in place for him along with a gully.
Fuller delivery and outside off, Matt pats it towards point.
Marginally ahead of a length, Renshaw rocks back and places it with an angled bat towards gully.
Renshaw backs away at the last moment. Bhuvneshwar Kumar is not happy, no bowler is when he has to abort his bowling.
On a length and outside off, Matt has left it alone.

FOUR! First runs on the board for Australia. Fuller delivery and outside off, Renshaw looks to defend off the front foot. But the ball stays low and takes the outside edge. It rolls away between the third slip and the gully fielder for a boundary.
Lands this on a length and well outside off, Matt shoulders his arms.
Initiates his spell with a length delivery which swings away, Renshaw goes back and defends it with soft hands towards the slip cordon.
